about_the_game:
1. Game Overview

A time-traveling ancient style male protagonist interactive AVG, with multiple endings and multiple branches, a journey of bonding with six close friends in a parallel world to dominate the world. Will you be a wise leader respected by all people, or a tyrant that everyone fears? Will you stick your back to your brother, or will you stick your back to your brother twice? How will you choose among the four female protagonists? Under the collision of modern thinking and ancient thought, on the road to the highest power, full of thorns, is it a Spring and Autumn Dream, or...

2. Game content

200,000 words of plot content

10 hours of game time

50+ background plot music

100+ exquisite CGs

All voice-overs except the protagonist

3. Game features

Ancient style group portrait story, diverse and full characters, bright colors, exquisite picture quality

Multiple choices, multiple branches, multiple endings, non-single choice jump ending mode

Every decision will affect the final outcome of each character, choose carefully

For example, there are ideological collisions of various schools of thought in the Spring and Autumn Period, and there are wonderful moments of playing chess with great scholars in parallel world history

Includes battle royale, spy war, comedy, dark, harem, warmth, affection, power, war, philosophy and other elements

Not stupid, all members are ruthless, without technology suppression, only relying on modern people's values, philosophical concepts, historical knowledge, culture and emotions and cognition engraved in the bones, counterattack all the way
